programs.name: suaddnoise
programs.purpose: Add Gaussian or uniform random noise to seismic traces, optionally filtering the noise first.

params.name: f
params.description: Comma-separated filter frequencies passed to sufilter.

params.name: amps
params.description: Comma-separated filter amplitudes passed to sufilter.

params.name: dt
params.default: computed: from header dt by sufilter
params.description: Sampling interval passed to sufilter; required by the filtering path when the header interval is unavailable.

params.name: tmpdir
params.default: computed: CWP_TMPDIR environment variable, otherwise empty

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Noise generation depends on SU's random generators. Noise power is accumulated sequentially in float; scaling mixes float arithmetic with double sqrt. The optional sufilter path adds FFT-dependent rounding. Zero noise power with nonzero signal can cause division by zero.
programs.difficulty_reason: It buffers the entire input and optionally runs an external FFT-based filter on generated noise.

test_cases.description: Gaussian noise with a fixed seed.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=8 | suaddnoise seed=123 sn=5 noise=gauss

test_cases.description: Uniform noise with a fixed seed.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=8 | suaddnoise seed=123 sn=10 noise=flat
suplane nt=128 ntr=8 | suaddnoise seed=123 sn=4 f=10,20,60,80 amps=0,1,1,0 dt=0.004

programs.name: sugroll
programs.purpose: Separate ground roll from a gather using a Karhunen-Loeve decomposition.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUGROLL - Ground roll supression using Karhunen-Loeve transform

params.name: dt
params.default: computed: first trace header dt divided by 1000000
params.description: Sample interval in seconds; required if the first header dt is zero.

params.name: nx
params.description: Upper index limit when zeroing discarded components.

params.name: sb
params.description: Zero outputs residual; nonzero outputs the selected components.

params.name: nrot
params.description: Number of leading components to retain.

params.name: tmpdir
params.default: computed: CWP_TMPDIR environment variable, otherwise empty

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Covariance and reconstruction use ordered float accumulations. The iterative Jacobi eigensolver uses float equality tests and double-library fabs and sqrt; its rotation loop bounds differ from the usual algorithm. Zero leading eigenvalue causes division by zero in diagnostics, and nx greater than the number of traces can access out of bounds.
programs.difficulty_reason: It forms a covariance matrix and performs an iterative Jacobi eigendecomposition on a buffered gather.

test_cases.description: Output the residual after removing two components.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=8 | sugroll dt=0.004 nrot=2 sb=0
suplane nt=128 ntr=8 | sugroll dt=0.004 nrot=1 nx=8 sb=1

programs.license_note: Credits BRGM author Adnand Bitri and cites a Geophysics paper by F. Xuewei Liu.

programs.name: suharlan
programs.purpose: Separate focused signal from noise using a Radon transform and Harlan's statistical extraction method.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUHARLAN - signal-noise separation by the invertible linear

params.name: tmpdir
params.default: computed: CWP_TMPDIR environment variable, otherwise empty

params.name: depthref
params.description: Reference depth; the selfdoc says 500 but the code sets zero.

params.name: c
params.description: Maximum noise allowed in a signal sample; the selfdoc says 0.04.

params.name: signal
params.description: Signal output filename; empty disables it.

params.name: noise
params.description: Noise output filename; empty disables it.

params.name: seed
params.default: computed: current time in seconds; 1 if time fails

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Radon transforms, histogram deconvolution, steepest descent, smoothing and convolution involve iterative and ordered floating-point calculations. Random noise depends on SU generators; sqrt and log are platform-sensitive. Diagnostic plot files and separate signal/noise files are written instead of stdout.
programs.difficulty_reason: It combines iterative statistical extraction, Radon transforms, smoothing and full-gather buffering across more than 1500 lines.

test_cases.description: Extract signal and noise with Gaussian random samples.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=8 | suharlan plot=0 verbose=0 seed=123 np=8 nintlh=20 sditer=2 signal=signal.su noise=noise.su

test_cases.description: Use uniform random samples and disable envelope and smoothing.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=8 | suharlan plot=0 verbose=0 seed=123 rgt=1 anenv=0 sts=0 np=8 nintlh=20 sditer=2 signal=signal.su noise=noise.su

programs.license_note: Credits say some routines are direct C translations of Fortran written by Dr. Bill Harlan.

programs.name: sujitter
programs.purpose: Apply random integer-sample time shifts to seismic traces.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUJITTER - Add random time shifts to seismic traces

params.name: pon
params.description: When 1, randomly choose shift sign; when 0, use positive shifts.

params.name: fldr
params.description: When 1, reuse a shift until the fldr header changes; when 0, choose per trace.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Float random values are converted to integer shifts by truncation. The shift loops access data[nt] for positive shifts and data beyond the trace end for negative shifts; vacated samples are not cleared, so output can depend on out-of-range or stale memory.
programs.difficulty_reason: It generates integer shifts and moves samples within each trace.

test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=8 | sujitter seed=123 min=1 max=4 pon=0 fldr=0

test_cases.description: Signed shifts shared by field record.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=8 | sujitter seed=123 min=1 max=3 pon=1 fldr=1

programs.license_note: Credits the University of Houston and Chris Liner.

programs.name: susembase
programs.purpose: Estimate local dips using semblance and use them to interpolate or smooth traces.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUSEMBASE - Semblance Based Structure-Oriented Interpolate and Smooth.

params.name: groupkey
params.description: Header key defining groups; absent means one group.

params.name: locmaxscan
params.description: Maximum location distance included in dip scanning; zero disables scanning.

params.name: scanstep
params.description: Dip scan increment; the selfdoc says 0.5.

params.name: dipuse
params.description: Use dips at input locations when 1 or output locations when 0.

params.name: locmaxsum
params.description: Maximum location distance included in summation; required when locmaxscan=0.

params.name: sumopt
params.description: Combination option: stack, sum, one, two, twolinear, dadstack or dadsum.

params.name: dadscale
params.description: Amplitude-difference scale; allowed with dadstack or dadsum.

params.name: dadnoise
params.description: Amplitude-difference noise threshold; allowed with dadstack or dadsum.

params.name: dadext
params.description: Amplitude-difference smoothing extent; allowed with dadstack or dadsum.

params.name: indip
params.description: Optional input dip trace filename; incompatible with explicit scan parameters.

params.name: bypass
params.description: Control copying or restricting output at existing input locations.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Dip selection compares semblance values accumulated in float; scanning, weighted smoothing and sinc interpolation depend on accumulation order and rounding. Location calculations mix doubles, floats and integer header values.
programs.difficulty_reason: It combines rolling multi-trace state, dip scanning, interpolation and several weighted summation modes.

test_cases.description: Scan dips and interpolate between CDP locations.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=8 | sushw key=cdp a=1 b=1 | susembase outputinc=0.5 scanstep=2 scanmax=8 locmaxscan=2

test_cases.description: Disable scanning and use amplitude-difference stacking.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=8 | sushw key=cdp a=1 b=1 | susembase locmaxscan=0 locmaxsum=2 sumopt=dadstack dadscale=1.2 dadext=8

test_cases.description: Use dips saved from a preceding run.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=8 | sushw key=cdp a=1 b=1 > in.su && susembase outdip=dip.su < in.su > first.su && susembase indip=dip.su sumopt=one < in.su

programs.name: susemgroup
programs.purpose: Estimate local dips and smooth traces within groups using semblance.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUSEMGROUP - Semblance Based Structure-Oriented Smooth In Trace Groups.

params.name: lockey
params.description: Location header key within a group.

params.name: groupkey
params.description: Group header key; none treats all traces as one group.

params.name: maxfold
params.description: Maximum number of traces in a group.

params.name: locmaxscan
params.description: Maximum location distance included in dip scanning; zero disables scanning.

params.name: dipuse
params.description: Choose whether dips are estimated at input or output locations.

params.name: locmaxsum
params.description: Maximum location distance included in the normalized sum; required when locmaxscan=0.

params.name: indip
params.description: Optional input dip trace filename; incompatible with explicit scan parameters.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Dip selection compares semblance values accumulated in float; scanning, weighted smoothing and sinc interpolation depend on accumulation order and rounding. Location calculations mix doubles, floats and integer header values.
programs.difficulty_reason: It buffers trace groups and performs dip scanning and sinc interpolation before weighted summation.

test_cases.description: Smooth a single group using CDP locations.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=8 | sushw key=cdp a=1 b=1 | susemgroup groupkey=none lockey=cdp locmaxscan=2 scanstep=2 scanmax=8 maxfold=16

test_cases.description: Disable scanning and sum nearby traces.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=8 | sushw key=cdp a=1 b=1 | susemgroup groupkey=none lockey=cdp locmaxscan=0 locmaxsum=2 maxfold=16
suplane nt=128 ntr=8 | sushw key=cdp a=1 b=1 > in.su && susemgroup groupkey=none lockey=cdp outdip=dip.su < in.su > first.su && susemgroup groupkey=none lockey=cdp indip=dip.su < in.su

programs.license_note: The credits state that this program was derived from susembase.
